# Oppsett

Denne delen laster pakkene, angir filbaner og samler analyseforutsetningene. Kontrollscenarioet ender på `r control_final_multiplier` ganger forventet innenlandssmitte og ukjent smittested, mens alle tre komponentene i det ugunstige scenarioet ender på `r adverse_final_multiplier` ganger referansebanen.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

Sys.setlocale(category = "LC_ALL", locale = "Norwegian")
.libPaths(c("U:/library", .libPaths()))

pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  tidylog,
  MASS,
  readxl,
  scales,
  knitr,
  patchwork
)

options(scipen = 999)
set.seed(030389)

theme_set(
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(colour = "#222222"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "#222222"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#222222"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

data_path <- paste0(
  "I:/MSIS_UtenPersonid/Resistente_mikrober/",
  "Risikovurdering CPO 2026/",
  "2026-11-10_CPO-risikovurdering.csv"
)

population_projection_path <- paste0(
  "I:/MSIS_UtenPersonid/Resistente_mikrober/",
  "Risikovurdering CPO 2026/",
  "Befolkning.xlsx"
)

esbl_path <- paste0(
  "I:/MSIS_UtenPersonid/Resistente_mikrober/",
  "Risikovurdering CPO 2026/",
  "ESBL_i_urin.xlsx"
)

output_path <- paste0(
  "I:/MSIS_UtenPersonid/Resistente_mikrober/",
  "Risikovurdering CPO 2026/"
)

first_observed_date <- as.Date("2013-01-01")
last_complete_year <- 2025
first_projection_year <- 2025
n_future_years <- 15
n_sim <- 5000
prediction_interval <- 0.95
lower_probability <- (1 - prediction_interval) / 2
upper_probability <- 1 - lower_probability

control_final_multiplier <- 0.50
adverse_final_multiplier <- 2.00

fhi_colours <- c(
  "Historisk fortsettelse" = "#40436d",
  "Kontrollscenario" = "#179463",
  "Ugunstig scenario" = "#d74b46"
)

country_colours <- c(
  "Norge, observert" = "#222222",
  "Norge, modelltilpasset" = "#65a9c5",
  "Norge, historisk fortsettelse" = fhi_colours[["Historisk fortsettelse"]],
  "Danmark, observert" = "#ec7c73",
  "ESBL E. coli, Norge" = "#7a5195",
  "ESBL K. pneumoniae, Norge" = "#ef5675"
)
```

# Klargjør kvartalsdata

Dataene leses inn på kvartalsnivå. Reisevariabelen er oppgitt i millioner reiser per kvartal og omregnes til antall reiser.

```{r prepare-quarterly-data}
dat_quarter <- read_csv2(
  data_path,
  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1")
) |>
  mutate(
    date = seq.Date(
      from = first_observed_date,
      by = "quarter",
      length.out = n()
    ),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    travel_n = travel_all * 1000000,
    cpo_modelled_total =
      CPO_smittested_Norge +
      CPO_smittested_øvrig_utland +
      CPO_smittested_ukjent
  )
```

# Aggreger til årsdata

Tilfeller og reiser summeres innen kalenderår, mens befolkningen settes til gjennomsnittlig kvartalsbefolkning. Det ufullstendige året 2026 vises som observert, men inngår ikke i modelltilpasningen.

```{r prepare-annual-data}

dat_year_observed <- dat_quarter |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    CPO_smittested_Norge = sum(CPO_smittested_Norge),
    CPO_smittested_øvrig_utland = sum(CPO_smittested_øvrig_utland),
    CPO_smittested_ukjent = sum(CPO_smittested_ukjent),
    cpo_modelled_total = sum(cpo_modelled_total),
    population = mean(population),
    travel_n = sum(travel_n),
    observed_quarters = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"))
  ) %>% 
  filter(year != 2026)

dat_year_model <- dat_year_observed |>
  filter(year <= last_complete_year) |>
  mutate(
    t_year = row_number(),
    t_year_c = t_year - max(t_year)
  )
```

# Les inn befolkningsframskriving

Befolkningsframskrivingen leses fra det vedlagte Excel-arket. Befolkningen i første prognoseår hentes fra observasjonsdataene, befolkningen i 2026 settes til 5 633 770, og verdiene fra 2027 og framover hentes fra arket.

```{r population-projection}
population_projection <- read_excel(
  population_projection_path,
  sheet = "14740",
  col_names = c("year", "population"),
  skip = 1
) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year),
    population = as.numeric(population)
  )

population_for_forecast <- bind_rows(
  dat_year_observed |>
    filter(year == first_projection_year) |>
    dplyr::select(year, population),
  tibble(
    year = 2026,
    population = 5633770
  ),
  population_projection
) |>
  distinct(year, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  arrange(year)
```

# Lag datasett for framskrivingsperioden

Framskrivingsperioden starter i `r first_projection_year` og dekker `r n_future_years` år. Befolkning kobles på fra befolkningsframskrivingen.

```{r future-data}
future_year <- tibble(
  year = first_projection_year + 0:(n_future_years - 1),
  t_year = max(dat_year_model$t_year) + year - last_complete_year,
  t_year_c = year - last_complete_year,
  date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01"))
) |>
  left_join(
    population_for_forecast,
    by = "year"
  )
```

# Tilpass hovedmodellene

Hovedanalysen bruker negativ-binomialregresjon med identity-link og et kvadratisk tidsledd. Modellene estimerer årlige antall direkte; befolkningen brukes først etter prediksjon til å uttrykke resultatene som rater.

```{r fit-main-models}
m_year_abroad <- glm.nb(
  CPO_smittested_øvrig_utland ~
    t_year_c + I(t_year_c^2),
  data = dat_year_model,
  link = "identity",
  init.theta = 1,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)

m_year_domestic <- glm.nb(
  CPO_smittested_Norge ~
    t_year_c + I(t_year_c^2),
  data = dat_year_model,
  link = "identity",
  init.theta = 1,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)

m_year_unknown <- glm.nb(
  CPO_smittested_ukjent ~
    t_year_c + I(t_year_c^2),
  data = dat_year_model,
  link = "identity",
  init.theta = 1,
  control = glm.control(maxit = 100)
)
```

# Lag scenarioene

Referansebanen viderefører modellert utvikling. Kontrollscenarioet demper innenlandssmitte og ukjent smittested gradvis til `r control_final_multiplier` av referansebanen. Det ugunstige scenarioet øker alle tre komponentene gradvis til `r adverse_final_multiplier` av referansebanen.

```{r create-scenarios}
control_multiplier_year <- seq(
  from = 1,
  to = control_final_multiplier,
  length.out = n_future_years
)

adverse_multiplier_year <- seq(
  from = 1,
  to = adverse_final_multiplier,
  length.out = n_future_years
)

future_year_scenarios <- bind_rows(
  future_year |>
    mutate(
      scenario = "Historisk fortsettelse",
      abroad_multiplier = 1,
      domestic_multiplier = 1,
      unknown_multiplier = 1
    ),
  future_year |>
    mutate(
      scenario = "Kontrollscenario",
      abroad_multiplier = 1,
      domestic_multiplier = control_multiplier_year,
      unknown_multiplier = control_multiplier_year
    ),
  future_year |>
    mutate(
      scenario = "Ugunstig scenario",
      abroad_multiplier = adverse_multiplier_year,
      domestic_multiplier = adverse_multiplier_year,
      unknown_multiplier = adverse_multiplier_year
    )
)
```

# Beregn punktestimater og standardfeil

Prediksjonene beregnes på responskalaen. Standardfeilen fra hver modell brukes som usikkerhet rundt forventet antall før framtidige tellinger simuleres fra negativ-binomialfordelingen.

```{r point-predictions}
pred_abroad <- predict(
  m_year_abroad,
  newdata = future_year_scenarios |>
    transmute(t_year_c),
  type = "response",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

pred_domestic <- predict(
  m_year_domestic,
  newdata = future_year_scenarios |>
    transmute(t_year_c),
  type = "response",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

pred_unknown <- predict(
  m_year_unknown,
  newdata = future_year_scenarios |>
    transmute(t_year_c),
  type = "response",
  se.fit = TRUE
)

annual_point_predictions <- future_year_scenarios |>
  mutate(
    abroad_unmodified = pmax(as.numeric(pred_abroad$fit), 0.001),
    abroad_se_unmodified = as.numeric(pred_abroad$se.fit),
    abroad = pmax(abroad_unmodified * abroad_multiplier, 0.001),
    abroad_se = abroad_se_unmodified * abroad_multiplier,
    domestic_unmodified = pmax(as.numeric(pred_domestic$fit), 0.001),
    domestic_se_unmodified = as.numeric(pred_domestic$se.fit),
    domestic = pmax(domestic_unmodified * domestic_multiplier, 0.001),
    domestic_se = domestic_se_unmodified * domestic_multiplier,
    unknown_unmodified = pmax(as.numeric(pred_unknown$fit), 0.001),
    unknown_se_unmodified = as.numeric(pred_unknown$se.fit),
    unknown = pmax(unknown_unmodified * unknown_multiplier, 0.001),
    unknown_se = unknown_se_unmodified * unknown_multiplier,
    total = abroad + domestic + unknown,
    total_rate_per_100k = total / population * 100000
  )
```

# Simuler prediksjonsintervaller

For hvert framtidig år trekkes først en forventningsverdi fra en normalfordeling rundt modellprediksjonen. Deretter trekkes framtidige tellinger fra den tilhørende negativ-binomialfordelingen.

```{r simulate-prediction-intervals}
simulate_row <- function(
  abroad,
  abroad_se,
  domestic,
  domestic_se,
  unknown,
  unknown_se,
  theta_abroad,
  theta_domestic,
  theta_unknown,
  n_sim
) {
  mu_abroad <- pmax(
    rnorm(n_sim, mean = abroad, sd = abroad_se),
    0.001
  )

  mu_domestic <- pmax(
    rnorm(n_sim, mean = domestic, sd = domestic_se),
    0.001
  )

  mu_unknown <- pmax(
    rnorm(n_sim, mean = unknown, sd = unknown_se),
    0.001
  )

  sim_abroad <- rnbinom(
    n_sim,
    mu = mu_abroad,
    size = theta_abroad
  )

  sim_domestic <- rnbinom(
    n_sim,
    mu = mu_domestic,
    size = theta_domestic
  )

  sim_unknown <- rnbinom(
    n_sim,
    mu = mu_unknown,
    size = theta_unknown
  )

  tibble(
    abroad_sim = sim_abroad,
    domestic_sim = sim_domestic,
    unknown_sim = sim_unknown,
    total_sim = sim_abroad + sim_domestic + sim_unknown
  )
}

simulation_results <- pmap(
  annual_point_predictions |>
    dplyr::select(
      abroad,
      abroad_se,
      domestic,
      domestic_se,
      unknown,
      unknown_se
    ),
  ~ simulate_row(
    abroad = ..1,
    abroad_se = ..2,
    domestic = ..3,
    domestic_se = ..4,
    unknown = ..5,
    unknown_se = ..6,
    theta_abroad = m_year_abroad$theta,
    theta_domestic = m_year_domestic$theta,
    theta_unknown = m_year_unknown$theta,
    n_sim = n_sim
  )
)

annual_predictions <- annual_point_predictions |>
  mutate(
    simulations = simulation_results
  ) |>
  mutate(
    abroad_lower = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$abroad_sim, lower_probability)
    ),
    abroad_upper = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$abroad_sim, upper_probability)
    ),
    domestic_lower = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$domestic_sim, lower_probability)
    ),
    domestic_upper = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$domestic_sim, upper_probability)
    ),
    unknown_lower = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$unknown_sim, lower_probability)
    ),
    unknown_upper = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$unknown_sim, upper_probability)
    ),
    total_lower = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$total_sim, lower_probability)
    ),
    total_upper = map_dbl(
      simulations,
      ~ quantile(.x$total_sim, upper_probability)
    ),
    rate_lower_per_100k = total_lower / population * 100000,
    rate_upper_per_100k = total_upper / population * 100000
  )
```

# Hovedfigur for scenarioene

Figuren viser totalantallet i et stort øvre panel og de tre smittestedene i mindre paneler under. Historisk fortsettelse er prioritert med en tykkere linje som tegnes oppå de to scenarioene.

```{r main-scenario-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
observed_year_long <- dat_year_observed |>
  transmute(
    date,
    Totalt = cpo_modelled_total,
    `Smitte ervervet i Norge` = CPO_smittested_Norge,
    `Smitte ervervet i øvrig utland` = CPO_smittested_øvrig_utland,
    `Ukjent smittested` = CPO_smittested_ukjent
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -date,
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "cases"
  )

predicted_year_long <- bind_rows(
  annual_predictions |>
    transmute(
      scenario,
      date,
      component = "Totalt",
      estimate = total,
      lower = total_lower,
      upper = total_upper
    ),
  annual_predictions |>
    transmute(
      scenario,
      date,
      component = "Smitte ervervet i Norge",
      estimate = domestic,
      lower = domestic_lower,
      upper = domestic_upper
    ),
  annual_predictions |>
    transmute(
      scenario,
      date,
      component = "Smitte ervervet i øvrig utland",
      estimate = abroad,
      lower = abroad_lower,
      upper = abroad_upper
    ),
  annual_predictions |>
    transmute(
      scenario,
      date,
      component = "Ukjent smittested",
      estimate = unknown,
      lower = unknown_lower,
      upper = unknown_upper
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = names(fhi_colours)
    )
  )

scenario_plot <- function(observed_data, predicted_data, use_facets = FALSE) {
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = predicted_data,
      aes(
        x = date,
        ymin = lower,
        ymax = upper,
        fill = scenario,
        group = scenario
      ),
      alpha = 0.12,
      colour = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = observed_data,
      aes(x = date, y = cases),
      colour = "#222222",
      linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = predicted_data |>
        filter(scenario != "Historisk fortsettelse"),
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = estimate,
        colour = scenario,
        group = scenario
      ),
      linewidth = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = predicted_data |>
        filter(scenario == "Historisk fortsettelse"),
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = estimate,
        colour = scenario,
        group = scenario
      ),
      linewidth = 2
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = fhi_colours) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fhi_colours) +
    scale_x_date(
      date_breaks = "3 years",
      date_labels = "%Y",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA),
      breaks = pretty_breaks(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Antall tilfeller per år",
      colour = "Scenario",
      fill = "Scenario"
    )

  if (use_facets) {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ component,
        scales = "free_y",
        nrow = 1
      )
  }

  p
}

p_total <- scenario_plot(
  observed_data = observed_year_long |>
    filter(component == "Totalt"),
  predicted_data = predicted_year_long |>
    filter(component == "Totalt")
) +
  labs(y = "Totalt antall tilfeller per år")

p_components <- scenario_plot(
  observed_data = observed_year_long |>
    filter(component != "Totalt"),
  predicted_data = predicted_year_long |>
    filter(component != "Totalt"),
  use_facets = TRUE
)

p_main <- (
  p_total /
    p_components
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1.45, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

print(p_main)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    output_path,
    "CPO_scenarioframskriving_aar.png"
  ),
  plot = p_main,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Sammenlign CPO i Norge og Danmark med ESBL i urin i Norge

Figuren viser norske og danske CPO-tall sammen med andelen ESBL-produserende E. coli- og K. pneumoniae-isolater fra urin i Norge. I panel to er dansk CPO og norsk ESBL forskjøvet ti år fram i tid, mens norsk CPO og den historiske framskrivingen står på opprinnelig tidspunkt.

```{r norway-denmark-esbl-comparison, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
esbl_urine <- read_excel(
  esbl_path,
  sheet = "Ark1"
) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(year)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(esbl_ecoli, esbl_kpneumoniae),
    names_to = "organism",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    series = recode(
      organism,
      esbl_ecoli = "ESBL E. coli, Norge",
      esbl_kpneumoniae = "ESBL K. pneumoniae, Norge"
    )
  )

denmark_cpo <- tibble(
  year = 2015:2024,
  cases = c(85, 99, 115, 160, 187, 207, 242, 335, 458, 527),
  series = "Danmark, observert"
)

norway_observed <- dat_year_observed |>
  transmute(
    year,
    cases = cpo_modelled_total,
    series = "Norge, observert"
  )

norway_fitted <- dat_year_model |>
  transmute(
    year,
    t_year_c,
    abroad = pmax(
      predict(
        m_year_abroad,
        newdata = pick(everything()),
        type = "response"
      ),
      0.001
    ),
    domestic = pmax(
      predict(
        m_year_domestic,
        newdata = pick(everything()),
        type = "response"
      ),
      0.001
    ),
    unknown = pmax(
      predict(
        m_year_unknown,
        newdata = pick(everything()),
        type = "response"
      ),
      0.001
    )
  ) |>
  transmute(
    year,
    cases = abroad + domestic + unknown,
    series = "Norge, modelltilpasset"
  )

norway_projected <- annual_predictions |>
  filter(scenario == "Historisk fortsettelse") |>
  transmute(
    year,
    cases = total,
    lower = total_lower,
    upper = total_upper,
    series = "Norge, historisk fortsettelse"
  )

panel_labels <- c(
  "A",
  "B"
)

cpo_panel_data <- bind_rows(
  bind_rows(
    norway_observed,
    norway_fitted,
    denmark_cpo
  ) |>
    mutate(panel = panel_labels[1]),
  bind_rows(
    norway_observed,
    norway_fitted,
    denmark_cpo |>
      mutate(year = year + 5)
  ) |>
    mutate(panel = panel_labels[2])
) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")),
    panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_labels)
  )

projected_panel_data <- bind_rows(
  norway_projected |>
    mutate(panel = panel_labels[1]),
  norway_projected |>
    mutate(panel = panel_labels[2])
) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")),
    panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_labels)
  )

esbl_panel_data <- bind_rows(
  esbl_urine |>
    mutate(panel = panel_labels[1]),
  esbl_urine |>
    mutate(
      year = year + 5,
      panel = panel_labels[2]
    )
) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste0(year, "-01-01")),
    panel = factor(panel, levels = panel_labels)
  )

cpo_ymax <- max(
  c(cpo_panel_data$cases,
    projected_panel_data$upper
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
)
esbl_scale_factor <- cpo_ymax/10

p_country <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = projected_panel_data,
    aes(
      x = date,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper,
      group = panel
    ),
    fill = fhi_colours[["Historisk fortsettelse"]],
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = cpo_panel_data |>
      filter(series != "Norge, modelltilpasset"),
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = cases,
      colour = series,
      group = interaction(panel, series)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = cpo_panel_data |>
      filter(series == "Norge, modelltilpasset"),
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = cases,
      colour = series,
      group = interaction(panel, series)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = esbl_panel_data,
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = percent * esbl_scale_factor,
      colour = series,
      group = interaction(panel, series)
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8,
    linetype = "dotdash"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = projected_panel_data,
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = cases,
      colour = series,
      group = panel
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ panel,
    ncol = 2,
    scales = "free_x"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = country_colours) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "3 years",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Antall CPO-tilfeller per år",
    limits = c(0, NA),
    breaks = pretty_breaks(),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / esbl_scale_factor,
      name = "ESBL-produserende isolater fra urin (%)",
      breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p_country)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(
    output_path,
    "CPO_Danmark_ESBL_sammenlikning.png"
  ),
  plot = p_country,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 300
)
```

# Tabell med årlige framskrivinger

Tabellen viser punktestimater og `r prediction_interval * 100` prosent prediksjonsintervaller for hvert scenario. Befolkningsratene er beregnet etter at modellen har predikert årlige antall.

```{r annual-projection-table}
annual_projection_table <- annual_predictions |>
  mutate(
    abroad_result = paste0(
      round(abroad),
      " (",
      round(abroad_lower),
      "-",
      round(abroad_upper),
      ")"
    ),
    domestic_result = paste0(
      round(domestic),
      " (",
      round(domestic_lower),
      "-",
      round(domestic_upper),
      ")"
    ),
    unknown_result = paste0(
      round(unknown),
      " (",
      round(unknown_lower),
      "-",
      round(unknown_upper),
      ")"
    ),
    total_result = paste0(
      round(total),
      " (",
      round(total_lower),
      "-",
      round(total_upper),
      ")"
    ),
    rate_result = paste0(
      round(total_rate_per_100k, 1),
      " (",
      round(rate_lower_per_100k, 1),
      "-",
      round(rate_upper_per_100k, 1),
      ")"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    scenario,
    year,
    abroad_result,
    domestic_result,
    unknown_result,
    total_result,
    rate_result
  )

kable(
  annual_projection_table,
  col.names = c(
    "Scenario",
    "År",
    "Ervervet i utlandet",
    "Ervervet i Norge",
    "Ukjent smittested",
    "Totalt",
    "Totalt per 100 000"
  ),
  caption = paste0(
    "Forventet antall CPO-tilfeller per år med ",
    prediction_interval * 100,
    " % prediksjonsintervall"
  )
)
```

# Eksporter hovedresultater

Hovedfiguren og årsresultatene lagres i prosjektmappen. Begge figurene og årsresultatene lagres i prosjektmappen.

```{r export-results}
write_csv2(
  annual_predictions |>
    dplyr::select(-simulations),
  paste0(
    output_path,
    "CPO_framskriving_aar_detaljert.csv"
  )
)

write_csv2(
  annual_projection_table,
  paste0(
    output_path,
    "CPO_framskriving_aar.csv"
  )
)

write_csv2(
  future_year,
  paste0(
    output_path,
    "CPO_framskrevne_eksponeringer_aar.csv"
  )
)
```
